name: marketing-launch-video
description: Produce a professional animated launch video for a software product from nothing but a URL. Browses the product, triages which screens carry the story, rebuilds the UI as frame-driven React in Remotion rather than screen-recording it, and choreographs camera, typography and sound into a 30-60 second cut. Renders real .glb meshes through three.js when the product outputs 3D.
